environment.description: Same service deployed behind Envoy sidecar proxy (Istio mesh) with ExtAuthz filter pointing to OPA policy engine. pgBouncer 1.21 configured with prepared_statement_cache_mode=force and statement-level pooling with disable_pqexec=1. The OPA policy (rego) validates that x-tenant-schema metadata values match regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,30}$ and x-target-table must equal literal 'schema_migrations'. pgBouncer's disable_pqexec=1 forces all queries through the extended query protocol, meaning SET commands and any non-parameterized f-string queries are rejected at the pooler level when they contain characters outside the prepared statement parse phase. The db role is restricted to USAGE on tenant schemas only (no CREATE/DROP on public).
